name: Resend
tagline: Send email from any agent over hosted MCP, OAuth or one API key.
description: Resend is an email API built for developers. The official MCP server exposes sending, contacts, audiences, broadcasts, and domain management; the REST API is small enough for an agent to learn in one read.

methods.label: OAuth (hosted MCP)
methods.note: Browser login to Resend, approved per client. Recommended for MCP clients that support OAuth.

methods.label: API key
methods.note: One key, sent as a bearer header. Works for headless MCP clients, the local MCP server and the REST API. Scoped keys can restrict to sending-only.

auth.guide:
**Hosted MCP with OAuth (fastest):** Resend hosts a Streamable HTTP server at `https://mcp.resend.com/mcp`. Connecting opens a browser window to log in to Resend and approve access.

```bash
claude mcp add --transport http resend https://mcp.resend.com/mcp
```

**API key (headless agents):** create a key at [resend.com/api-keys](https://resend.com/api-keys) (`re_…`). Keys can be **full access** or restricted to **sending access** only — prefer the latter for agents that just send mail. Pass it to the hosted server as a bearer header:

```bash
claude mcp add --transport http resend https://mcp.resend.com/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer $RESEND_API_KEY"
```

**Local MCP (stdio):** the open-source server runs on your machine with the same key:

```bash
claude mcp add resend -e RESEND_API_KEY=$RESEND_API_KEY -- npx -y resend-mcp
```

The same header works against the REST API (`curl https://api.resend.com/emails -H "Authorization: Bearer $RESEND_API_KEY"`). You'll need a verified sending domain before production sends — set one up under [Domains](https://resend.com/domains).

interfaces.name: Resend MCP
interfaces.note: OAuth in supporting clients (browser login); API-key bearer header for headless agents. Local stdio alternative: npx -y resend-mcp

interfaces.name: Resend MCP (local)
interfaces.install: claude mcp add resend -e RESEND_API_KEY=re_xxx -- npx -y resend-mcp
interfaces.note: Open-source server; runs locally over stdio with your API key (RESEND_API_KEY).
